labelMethod: Historical Inven/Codex reference images were used to select visually equivalent local crops (correlation >= 0.99, margin >= 0.05, mean RGB error <= 5). Names and rarity are verified against SeasonCard/GameMsg. This is not an authoritative DB-to-UV mapping. External reference pixels are not distributed. Additional display-only entries carry individual visual identification evidence. Duplicate portraits are valid for display but are not promoted to recognition references.
